correctness.rationale: For H=K_{a,b}-F without isolates, a size-3 TD-set consists of a full vertex on one shore plus an opposite-shore covering pair. If |F|<b, some B-vertex is full and the A missing-neighbor sets must intersect pairwise; for a>=3 each has size >=2 unless an isolate occurs, forcing |F|>=2a. Constructions attain b or 2a; pairwise-intersecting two-sets either form a star (forbidden isolate) or triangle. Counting surjections gives all extremal cuts. Exhaustively tested direct 2/3-vertex total domination after each edge deletion through (3,7), including boundary (3,6) with 660 cuts.
